commands.name: /agents
commands.description: List the open agents and switch to one.

commands.name: /allowlist
commands.description: Inspect or change persistent permission rules.

commands.name: /clear
commands.description: Start a fresh conversation and keep background processes running.

commands.name: /close
commands.description: Close the instance on screen. Closing the last one exits fx.

commands.name: /compact
commands.description: Summarize older conversation context.

commands.name: /copy
commands.description: Copy the latest assistant response.

commands.name: /credits
commands.description: Show the AI Gateway credit balance. /balance is an alias.

commands.name: /effort
commands.description: Choose the reasoning effort for the current model, or pass a level such as high.

commands.name: /fast
commands.description: Toggle Fast mode, or turn it on or off. Turning it on needs a model that supports it.

commands.name: /feedback
commands.description: Open the fx feedback form.

commands.name: /fork
commands.description: Start a new conversation from before a chosen prompt, with that prompt in the composer to edit. See Fork a conversation.

commands.name: /help
commands.description: Show interactive help.

commands.name: /image
commands.description: Attach an image. /img is an alias.

commands.name: /images
commands.description: List pending images, or remove them with clear.

commands.name: /launch
commands.description: Start another fx instance, optionally in an agent profile, and show it.

commands.name: /login
commands.description: Open the provider picker to sign in.

commands.name: /logout
commands.description: Sign out of the active or named provider.

commands.name: /mcp
commands.description: Connect and manage MCP servers. See Interactive MCP commands.

commands.name: /model
commands.description: Choose a model and reasoning effort, or pass a model ID or search term.

commands.name: /paste
commands.description: Attach a clipboard image when supported.

commands.name: /permissions
commands.description: Show the permission mode, rules, and session grants in a panel, or change the mode. reset switches back to ask and clears the session grants.

commands.name: /provider
commands.description: Choose a provider and how to connect to it. /setup still opens it with a warning until fx 0.0.18.

commands.name: /quit
commands.description: Exit fx. /exit is an alias.

commands.name: /rename
commands.description: Rename the current conversation.

commands.name: /reset
commands.description: Start a fresh conversation and stop workspace background processes.

commands.name: /resume
commands.description: Open the saved-session picker.

commands.name: /settings
commands.description: Open settings. With startup-scrollback, turn the startupscrollback setting on or off, or toggle it.

commands.name: /shell
commands.description: Reload shell startup configuration and clear remembered command approvals.

commands.name: /skills
commands.description: Browse and manage skills with show, install, create, remove, and path. add is an alias of install.

commands.name: /sound
commands.description: Turn sounds and terminal bells on or off, or toggle them with no argument. max adds interaction sounds.

commands.name: /stats
commands.description: Show terminal rendering counters for this fx process: bytes of terminal output, redraws, debounced resizes, footer updates, and stream chunks. For usage and spend, use /usage.

commands.name: /status
commands.description: Show the session ID, model, workspace, and permissions in a panel.

commands.name: /statusline
commands.description: Choose which fields appear in the footer, or toggle the one you name.

commands.name: /trace
commands.description: Create and copy a private diagnostic trace.

commands.name: /ultrafast
commands.description: Enable, disable, or inspect the higher-priced Ultrafast request. With no argument, show status without changing it.

commands.name: /undo
commands.description: Undo the most recent tracked file operation.

commands.name: /usage
commands.description: Show your provider's usage and spend: AI Gateway reports, or your Codex or Grok plan usage.

commands.name: /version
commands.description: Show the installed version.

commands.name: /workspace
commands.description: Manage saved additional directories. With no argument, open them in a list.
